package.description: Lightweight ping monitoring alert tool for Windows.

en-US.description: Lightweight ping monitoring alert tool for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: PingAlert is a standalone lightweight monitoring tool for Windows that checks multiple hosts in parallel using worker threads and sends alerts when hosts become unreachable or recover. It is designed for small and middle business monitoring without a complex server setup.
en-US.name: PingAlert
